examples.text: vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ, padakkhiṇañ'ca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ.

78617.commentary: (DNa) mahim'iva suro abhivassan'ti suro vuccati devo, mahāpathaviṃ abhivassanto devo viya.

examples.text: akkodhañ'ca adhiṭṭhahi adāsi, dānañ'ca vatthāni sukhumāni succhavīni, purimatarabhave ṭhito abhivissaji, mahim'iva suro abhivassaṃ.
yathā vā pana, mahārāja, mahatimahāmegho abhivassanto tiṇarukkhapasumanussānaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ deti santatiṃ anupāleti. vuṭṭh'ūpajīvino c'ete sattā sabbe, na ca mahāmeghassa mayh'ete'ti apekkhā hoti.

so puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ kārāpetvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā khar'ājinaṃ nivāsetvā sappitelena kāyaṃ abbhañjitvā magavisāṇena piṭṭhiṃ kaṇḍuvamāno navaṃ santh'āgāraṃ pavisati, saddhiṃ mahesiyā brāhmaṇena ca purohitena.
atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā purohitena brāhmaṇena saddhiṃ yena so ambo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā ucce āsane nisīditvā mantaṃ pariyāpuṇāti.

78621.meaning1: not exceeding; not transcending; not going beyond

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! nissāya nissāya kira no, bhante, bhagavatā oghassa nittharaṇā akkhātā.

78689.commentary: (MNa) oghassa nittharaṇā akkhātā'ti oghataraṇaṃ kathitaṃ, tatiyajjhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā ṭhitabhikkhuno oghanittharaṇā kathitā… n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ pādakaṃ katvā ṭhitabhikkhuno oghanittharaṇā kathitā'ti vadati.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante! nissāya nissāya kira no, bhante, bhagavatā oghassa nittharaṇā akkhātā.
na ca kho, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā sabbaṃ jhānaṃ vaṇṇesi, na'pi so bhagavā sabbaṃ jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesī'ti. kathaṃ rūpañ'ca, brāhmaṇa, so bhagavā jhānaṃ na vaṇṇesi?

evam'eva kho, brāhmaṇa, tathāgato purisadammaṃ labhitvā paṭhamaṃ evaṃ vineti, ehi tvaṃ, bhikkhu, sīlavā hohi, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesū'ti.

78692.meaning1: (of a posture, sitting or lying down) adopts; takes up; assumes; uses; sits (on); lies down (in)
78692.commentary: (ANa) sīhaseyyaṃ kappetī'ti sīho viya seyyaṃ kappeti. (THa) seyyaṃ kappetī'ti arahattappattisamanantaraṃ sayitattā vuttaṃ. thero hi bahu'd'eva rattiṃ caṅkamena vītināmetvā sarīraṃ utuṃ gāhāpetuṃ ovarakaṃ pavisitvā sayituṃ mañcake nisinno pādā ca bhūmito muttā, appattañ'ca sīsaṃ bimbohanaṃ, etth'antare arahattaṃ patvā sayi.

examples.text: rattiyā majjhimaṃ yāmaṃ dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ kappeyyāsi pāde pādaṃ accādhāya sato sampajāno uṭṭhānasaññaṃ manasikaritvā, rattiyā pacchimaṃ yāmaṃ paccuṭṭhāya caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhehī'ti.
yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya

78693.meaning1: gives way; offers right of way

examples.text: idha, māṇava, ekacco itthī vā puriso vā thaddho hoti atimānī, abhivādetabbaṃ na abhivādeti, paccuṭṭhātabbaṃ na paccuṭṭheti, āsan'ārahassa na āsanaṃ deti, magg'ārahassa na maggaṃ deti

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, subhūmiyaṃ catumahāpathe ājaññaratho yutto assa ṭhito odhastapatodo, tam'enaṃ dakkho yogg'ācariyo assadammasārathi abhiruhitvā vāmena hatthena rasmiyo gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena patodaṃ gahetvā yen'icchakaṃ yadicchakaṃ sāreyyā'pi paccāsāreyyā'pi

tam'enaṃ uparipabbate ṭhito sahāyako heṭṭhimapabbatapādaṃ orohitvā taṃ sahāyakaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā uparipabbataṃ āropetvā muhuttaṃ assāsetvā evaṃ vadeyya, yaṃ, samma, kiṃ tvaṃ passasi uparipabbate ṭhito'ti?

atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ nandaṃ bāhāyaṃ gahetvā, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya, evam'eva, jetavane antarahito devesu tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.

78696.meaning1: feet up, head down; upside down; head over heels

examples.text: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti. tam'enaṃ, bhikkhave, nirayapālā uddhaṃpādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādittāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya. so tattha pheṇ'uddehakaṃ paccati.
ettha ky'āhaṃ, bho gotama, karomi? magg'akkhāyī'haṃ, bho gotamā'ti.

78698.meaning1: having sense-doors; with the six sense fields
78698.commentary: (MNa) indriyesu aguttadvārā'ti chasu indriyesu asaṃvutakammadvārā. (ANa) indriyesu guttadvāro'ti manacchaṭṭhesu indriyesu pihitadvāro.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā assaddhā jīvik'atthā na saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā saṭhā māyāvino ketabino uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā indriyesu aguttadvārā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.

78699.grammar: ind, adv, in comps, acc sg of pubba
78699.commentary: (MNa) pubbaṅ'gamo'ti purato gāmī nāyako. (ANa) sabb'ete manopubbaṅ'gamā'ti mano pubbaṃ paṭhamataraṃ gacchati etesan'ti manopubbaṅ'gamā.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā… sikkhāya na tibbagāravā bāhulikā sāthalikā okkamane pubbaṅ'gamā paviveke nikkhittadhurā kusītā hīnavīriyā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā duppaññā eḷamūgā, na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ sukham'anveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī
